Our CPM-based programme is structured to deliver CDA’s city-wide Safe-City CCTV network and Command & Control Centre within the required 18 months, using parallel workstreams for design, civil works, fibre backbone, and systems integration. TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will execute under a single integrated schedule managed by PMP-certified project managers and PEC-registered engineers in our organisation. [CO-PROFILE]

Months 1–2: Mobilisation, surveys, and IFC design. We will complete route/corridor surveys, camera site confirmation, pole/foundation typologies, fibre backbone design, and Command & Control Centre (C&CC) layout. Our planning approach is anchored in our network design delivery experience, where design-to-deployment programmes were managed over extended durations (e.g., 21 months), informing realistic sequencing and approvals. [CAP-009][CAP-021]

Months 2–14: Civil works and backbone build (rolling fronts). We will run multiple crews for pole foundations, underground ducting, and redundant fibre backbone installation, with traffic-management and site safety plans applied on live roads in line with our documented HSE policy used on infrastructure deployments. [CO-PROFILE]

Months 4–15: Supply, installation, and configuration (rolling). Cameras, field cabinets, power interfaces, and network equipment will be installed progressively as civil sections are released.

Months 6–16: C&CC build-out and cybersecurity-by-design. We will implement the data systems under our ISO 27001-certified information security management system and integrate storage and operations workflows. [CO-PROFILE][CAP-001]

Months 16–18: End-to-end testing, commissioning, training, and handover. A dedicated defect-liability closeout plan and O&M readiness will be completed with our in-country support desk model and preventive maintenance approach. [CO-PROFILE]

Our library does not yet evidence delivery of a PKR 1,500M+ safe-city project as prime contractor; therefore, we will mitigate schedule and integration risk by proposing a qualified specialist consortium partner for large-scale CCTV/analytics while TechnoCore leads programme controls, cybersecurity governance, and civil-work coordination. [CO-PROFILE]
